      private static String calcAdler32Checksum(String mac)
      Only used to truncate the HMAC to 32 bits. This reduces security and increases the likelihood of collisions, but requires less bandwidth.
      Parameter:
      mac - Original HMAC/CMAC/GMAC
      Gibt zurück:
      Reduced MAC, shortened to 32Bit
